sources.title: GitHub Primer button
sources.finding: Primary, secondary and quiet button variants establish action hierarchy. Loading, inactive, focus and keyboard states are documented.
sources.limits: Rendered official component documentation inspected after the initial HTTP client timed out.

sources.title: Material Design lists
sources.finding: Use ordered, scannable lists with consistently positioned text and trailing actions.
sources.limits: The initial HTML was a JavaScript shell; the rendered page was inspected separately.

sources.title: WAI modal dialog pattern
sources.finding: Modal content is active while background content is inert. Initial focus, Escape and focus restoration are necessary parts of the pattern.
sources.limits: Standards guidance informs behavior; native dialog use alone is not a complete accessibility assessment.

sources.title: Nielsen Norman progressive disclosure
sources.finding: Progressive disclosure keeps frequent actions visible while deferring infrequent detail.
sources.limits: Applied to pack imports, hints, notification setup and grouped pack previews; no measured cognitive-load improvement claimed.

sources.title: MDN popover top layer
sources.finding: Dialogs and popovers use a top layer distinct from ordinary stacking contexts.
sources.limits: The fix uses an in-dialog feedback region, not a z-index increase or a popover dependency.

sources.title: GOV.UK Design System layout
sources.finding: Start with a single column on small screens, constrain page width, and limit reading lines. A common page wrapper aligns headings and content.
sources.application: One shared 1080px frame for the top bar and all six pages; a narrower, aligned reading column for documentation. Supporting Today content follows the main task.
sources.limits: Official rendered guidance inspected. Ascend uses its own widths and visual style; no usability outcome is inferred from the reference.

sources.title: USWDS card usage guidance
sources.finding: Cards are modular summaries, not generic decorative borders. Sequential content is better presented with lists, body text and headings; simple calls to action need buttons.
sources.application: Replace the stacked dashboard sidebar, settings panels, path containers and Stats card grid with sections and rows. Keep the main challenge visually distinct.
sources.limits: Official rendered component guidance inspected; this is an adaptation, not a claim that Ascend implements the USWDS card component.

sources.title: Carbon Design System 2x Grid
sources.finding: Shared alignment lines and consistent margins, padding and gutters create a visual rhythm. Fluid columns suit dashboards; breakpoint checks preserve layout integrity.
sources.application: Use common page edges, 24/32px section spacing, one Stats metric strip and an aligned chart row. Validate every page from 320px to 1920px.
sources.limits: Official rendered guidance inspected. Layout checks and screenshots establish geometry, not a measured cognitive-load or learning benefit.

sources.title: Vite documentation navigation
sources.finding: Desktop documentation uses a persistent topic sidebar and aligned article headings and body; compact screens expose a Menu control.
sources.application: Use grouped topics in a stable desktop rail, and a native overlay drawer on compact screens. Search filters within navigation instead of inserting content above the article.
sources.limits: Public rendered pages inspected at desktop and compact widths. Patterns are adapted to Ascend’s small in-app guide; no third-party assets or usability scores are copied.

sources.title: React documentation reading layout
sources.finding: Grouped navigation sits separately from the title, introduction and article in one reading column.
sources.application: Keep the article title and body aligned; use short topic groups with a distinct current guide.
sources.limits: Public rendered pages inspected at desktop and compact widths. Patterns are adapted to Ascend’s small in-app guide; no third-party assets or usability scores are copied.

sources.title: GitHub Docs article layout
sources.finding: The title, description and article sections share a reading column alongside persistent topic navigation.
sources.application: Replace the generic Docs page headline with the actual guide title; preserve stable links and independent topic navigation.
sources.limits: Public rendered pages inspected at desktop and compact widths. Patterns are adapted to Ascend’s small in-app guide; no third-party assets or usability scores are copied.

sources.title: React Bits Aurora and entrance effects
sources.finding: Aurora uses a configurable animated light field. FadeContent and BlurText use staggered entrances and reduced-motion handling.
sources.application: Short heading/section entrances preserve complete accessible text. The earlier CSS light field was replaced by printed geometry in the neobrutalist theme.
sources.limits: The public page returned a blank client-rendered body in the audit browser; official repository source was inspected instead. No React Bits code or shaders were copied.

sources.title: Aceternity UI Aurora Background
sources.finding: A slow aurora and radial gradient mask give the backdrop depth without adding content containers.
sources.application: The earlier aurora informed slow background movement. The current neobrutalist theme uses outlined geometry and a sparse dot field; Docs receives lower background contrast.
sources.limits: Rendered public documentation and preview inspected. Ascend uses original CSS without React/Tailwind dependencies or copied components.

sources.title: Magic UI Dot Pattern
sources.finding: A sparse dot field can be masked and combined with a glow to give otherwise empty background space texture.
sources.application: A faint CSS dot field, sparse drifting particles and a thin orbit motif in the outer margin.
sources.limits: Rendered public component documentation and examples inspected; no component implementation copied.

sources.title: Motion accessibility guidance
sources.finding: Respect reduced-motion settings, avoid large transform/parallax effects, and allow a site-level preference.
sources.application: Device reduced motion overrides decoration; a saved Profile preference stops effects. The top-bar motion button was removed at the user’s request. Background motion pauses when the document is hidden.
sources.limits: Official page text read from HTTP HTML after the rendered browser timed out. Motion’s APIs are reference guidance; the implementation uses CSS and the Web Animations API.

sources.title: Neobrutalism Components introduction
sources.finding: Rendered documentation uses thick outlines, flat color surfaces, heavy typography, small corners and offset shadows on controls.
sources.application: Original CSS tokens for ink outlines, paper surfaces, mustard primary actions, lavender selection and hard shadows. Preserve the existing open layouts and native accessible controls.
sources.limits: Public rendered documentation inspected. No React, Tailwind or Base UI component code copied; no new runtime dependency.

sources.title: Gumroad public home page
sources.finding: Public page combines a restrained base surface with outlined controls, large headings and selective flat colorful illustrations.
sources.application: Keep color concentrated on important actions and geometric decoration; use strong typography and whitespace instead of adding more card containers.
sources.limits: Public home page text and screenshot inspected, not an authenticated creator dashboard. Branding and illustrations are not reused.

sources.title: Linear public home page

sources.application: Reduce repeated instructions on challenge summaries; use a small upward-moving illustration and retain complete instructions in the workspace.
sources.limits: Public rendered home page text and screenshot inspected. No authenticated workspace, loading flow or usability outcomes were audited.
